svg.title: Sub-Engine — brand system
svg.desc: The Sub-Engine identity on one board: mark, anatomy, product surfaces, promise, colour, type, social card, image direction, detail.
svg.text: Two seams the data rests on. One gate every system crosses.
An ECS core that runs without a browser. Entities are integers,
components are flat JSON, systems are pure functions.
One accent, inherited from Type-3. Used once per surface.
the engine speaks in data, so the identity does too
Entities are integers. Components are flat JSON.
A flow field, not a photograph.
the cursor is the only other orange thing
